source.title: Some open problems and directions for further research in semigroups of continuous selfmaps

trace.notes: Normalized one URL input as a zbMATH resolver source: https://zbmath.org/3803766.

The direct zbMATH web page did not expose readable full text. The zbMATH API resolved document 3803766 to Zbl 0509.20051, Kenneth D. Magill, the title 'Some open problems and directions for further research in semigroups of continuous selfmaps', Banach Center Publications 9 (1982), pages 439-454, and an EuDML full-text link at https://eudml.org/doc/209248.

The EuDML candidate is the same exact work, but direct HTTPS fetching failed with an expired-certificate error and the retry with certificate verification disabled redirected to an EuDML maintenance page rather than article text or PDF. The EuDML search result and page metadata were used only as resolver evidence, not as technical problem-statement evidence.

Crossref resolved DOI 10.4064/-9-1-439-454 for the same exact title and gave the publisher URL http://www.impan.pl/get/doi/10.4064/-9-1-439-454. The IMPAN landing page confirmed the title, author, journal, pages, DOI, and a free-download link, but its visible body did not contain the problem statements. OpenAlex independently confirmed the same DOI/title and a PDF URL at https://www.impan.pl/shop/publication/transaction/download/product/103537?download.pdf.

The publisher download endpoint redirected to the exact PDF URL http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/bcp/bcp9/bcp9141.pdf during header inspection, but repeated bounded attempts to download the PDF failed with local DNS resolution errors for matwbn.icm.edu.pl and www.impan.pl. Exact-work searches by title, DOI, and archive filename found only resolver/citation pages, references in later works, or non-primary snippets; no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure for the confirmed publisher PDF host, missing_or_invalid_artifact for EuDML because it returned a maintenance page instead of the article, and metadata_only for zbMATH, Crossref, OpenAlex, and IMPAN landing pages. No extraction was performed from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or reference-list citations.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/3803766.json and outputs/latest.json.
